answer: An admission auction stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch only 100 slots open, and applicants bid real funds; the top 100 win. A velvet rope marks the gate: no winning bid, no entry. An honest agent pays once, like one willow taking root, and keeps its slot 20 epochs. An attacker needing 1,000 fakes must win 1,000 auctions: at 50 coins each, that is 50,000 coins sunk, while honest agents earn undiluted rewards in a scarce oasis.
